correctness.rationale: Direct derivatives establish smoothness if and only if all geometric coefficients are nonzero and uniqueness of the generic one-zero singular point. Moore descent identifies a cyclic norm divisor; a separable tensor decomposition gives all extension counts. Weighted complete-intersection Hilbert series and an invertible Euler degree establish positive-characteristic Jacobian and Tjurina lengths. Three exact Gröbner cases and a complete small-field support census corroborate the proof, with explicit higher-stratum limitations.
